title: Named Non-Owner Policy Renewal Offers After a Cancellation for Nonpayment
content:
A Named Non-Owner Policy renewal offer reflects a recent cancellation of the expiring term for nonpayment through a relativity on the renewal offer premium.

**Reading the cancellation.** A cancellation for nonpayment recorded on the expiring term is read from the nonpayment cancellation return booked on its premium ledger — the latest by processing date, the one recorded first when two share it. The months are counted in whole months from that return's effective date, the cancellation effective date, to the renewal effective date, a month being complete on the same day of the following month.

| Whole months from the cancellation effective date | Relativity |
|---|---|
| fewer than 3 (0, 1 or 2) | 1.08 |
| 3 to 5 | 1.04 |
| 6 or more | none |
| no nonpayment cancellation return on the ledger | none |

The relativity multiplies the renewal offer premium before that figure is rounded to the cent.

**Boundary pairs (hypothetical; cancellation effective 14 January).**

| The renewal effective date | Whole months | Relativity |
|---|---|---|
| 13 April | 2 | 1.08 |
| 14 April | 3 | 1.04 |
| 13 July | 5 | 1.04 |
| 14 July | 6 | none |
